name: nested-package-dependency-scope
description: A nested package's dependency is needed only by a use written at or below the nested package's directory, so a dependency the root and a nested package both declare, which only a root file imports, is reported in the nested manifest alone. A nested package's enabling package and dependency that nothing installs apply no row, raise no setup failure and are not judged, because no run requires a nested package to be installed, while the target's own uninstalled dependency is judged by the import closure alone.
